transcript: If the moon and the sun are not competing, then there is no need for us to compete either. They don't rush each other. They don't compare. They don't try to outshine. Everyone has their time to shine. The moon is not jealous of the sun. It patiently waits for its moment, knowing its light is just as beautiful in the right season. Right now, it may be the sun's time to shine, and when the sky shifts, it will be yours. If this message found you at the right time, comment, My time is coming, and share this with someone who needs to stop comparing and start trusting their season.
